title: US government warns of ‘ongoing cyber threat’ amid mass hacks of industrial retail and military freezers
slides: Why is the US warning about hacked freezers now?
Industrial, retail and military cold storage systems are compromised.
The attackers aren't after data — they want physical disruption.
Check your cold-chain devices for unknown outbound connections.
One unpatched freezer is a door into your whole network.
thread_text:
1. Your Freezer Is a Backdoor

US agencies just warned that hacked cold storage systems are being used for physical sabotage, not data theft.

2. Cold Chain Under Siege

Industrial, retail, and military refrigeration units have all been compromised in coordinated attacks.

3. They Want Disruption, Not Data

Attackers are skipping ransomware and going straight for physical chaos—spoiled goods, broken supply lines.

4. Check Outbound Connections

Look for unknown outbound traffic from your cold-chain devices. That's the telltale sign of a compromised freezer.

5. One Freezer, Whole Network

An unpatched freezer is a door into your entire network. Patch it today or segment it off—your call.
